scope: Retain supported frozen primary crops; independent affine notch/edge proposals only after rejection. Forty-two photos in two distinct cohorts; no retraining or model integration.
method: Find the deepest upper silhouette concavity relative to its convex hull after handle trimming, then combine this visible notch with the exposed lower edges into an affine parallelogram. No ideal cap outlines or template-fit scores enter the proposal.
policy: Retain every supported baseline crop exactly. For rejected inputs, compare one-point and two-paper SAM fields at upright and four covariance-derived orientations. Select the supported proposal with lowest source-only evidence score; no downstream fit-based selection.
limitations: Affine assumption may not fit perspective or deformed paper.
Model body/paper predictions are not independent ground truth.
The twenty new-source images have now been inspected: this is a development follow-up, not another untouched generalization estimate.
All original observed pixels and existing final image/feature/geometry/paper/editor checks are retained.
No learned model or notch locator is integrated into the application.
validation: Six analytic/synthetic checks before source-photo inference, including known unequal caps, source identity, paper exchange and undersized-crop evidence.
Inspect all additional and rejected crop proposals, then fit every available selected crop in both cohorts with the unchanged ten-second settings.
Verify all prior crop geometry, material masks and observation support are unchanged; do not pool cohorts into a claimed generalization rate.
